result:
I made one change this run: the old scheduler now runs at most one FEBio run at a time. The reason is that /raid has only 7–8 GB free.

**What's running (10:00)**
- **Old FEBio queue:** empty. Pass 1 of physrotD finished; the last run (p144) ended at 09:43. Totals: 2010 done, 2 failed.
- **Pass-1 screen:** h29 (`rot_chain`) is running the e04 slip-out check on the pass-1 results. It has written about 131 of ~190 result files. When it finishes, it will queue pass 2 (physrotD2), probably in about an hour.
- **Evo task queue:** empty. The 5 `gate2_*` failures are from 10-28 and haven't changed.
- **Services:** all 7 tmux sessions are up. Nothing is hung or dead.

**What's idle and why**
- **CPU:** load 4.1 out of a 32-core quota.
- **GPUs:** all 7 are at 0%, and none of the memory in use on them is ours.
- **Memory:** fine. Real process memory is 5.8 GiB; the cgroup total looks near its 128 GiB cap only because 124 GiB of it is file cache the system can free.
- **The real limit is disk:** /raid is 100% full with 7–8 GB free. Each pass-1 run directory is 2.5–2.8 GB, so there is room for only about 2 more runs.

**What I changed**
- In `scripts/5_compute/h19_scheduler.py` I lowered `CPU_OVERCOMMIT` from 0.25 to 0.125. That caps it at one 4-core run at a time. I then restarted `biocage_sched`; no runs were in flight, so nothing was interrupted.
- **Why:** with two runs at a time, two could finish and two more start between my hourly checks, which needs over 10 GB. With one at a time, the next check can stop new launches before /raid fills. Pass 2 loses no real speed, because the disk only has room for about 2 runs anyway.

**Needs a person**
1. **Urgent:** free at least 100 GB on /raid. Then set `CPU_OVERCOMMIT` back to 1.5 and restart `biocage_sched`.
2. Decide whether to add a disk-space check to h19 so it won't start a run when there isn't room for it. I'm only allowed to edit h19's settings block, so I can't add this myself.
3. If the disk isn't freed, the next check will pause launches (`CPU_OVERCOMMIT=0`) once 1–2 pass-2 runs have finished.

The report is in `work/agents/foreman/report_20261030_1000.md`. I also updated `status.json` (with the Traditional Chinese summary) and added a line to `work/ops/foreman_actions.log`.
